findings.title: Recheck cancellation and original deadline after retirement join
findings.trigger: A valid retiring result arrives, groupGone stays false, then cancellation or original outer deadline occurs before group reaping succeeds.
findings.observedFromSource: execute awaits retire then returns response without check(); stopCall records callFailure but fault() returns for current.retiring.
findings.impact: A successful DTO can resolve after cancellation/deadline. Caller-signal publication fences help cancellation, but original outer timer only sets local callFailure so a late success can be persisted.
findings.recommendedFix: Run check() and the unchanged original deadline check after awaited retirement and immediately before returning, with delayed-group cancel/deadline controls.
findings.reproducer: Fake retiring reply; groupGone false until2s; timeout100ms (outer1600ms), then groupGone true. Current source returns response.

checkedAreas: Async startup hashing cancellation and no hidden queue
Kill/groupGone join and fatal quarantine before lane replacement
Advisory-owner lifecycle and preserved authority/dependency publication fences
limitations: Independent Linux qualification is a separate owner scope.
This finding receipt captures reviewed bytes before the coordinated fix.
